description: This file contains Kotlin source code for handling location services in an Android application. It defines an interface for location data sourcing, a default implementation that interacts with Android's location permissions and providers, and a LocationHandler class responsible for managing location fetch requests, including permission checks, parameter parsing, and error handling.

classes.name: LocationDataSource
classes.description: An interface defining methods for checking location permissions and fetching location data asynchronously.

classes.name: DefaultLocationDataSource
classes.description: A default implementation of LocationDataSource that interacts with Android's location permissions and the given LocationCaptureManager.

classes.name: LocationHandler
classes.description: A class responsible for handling location requests, managing permissions, parameters, and responding with location data or errors.

methods.name: hasFineLocationPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION permission.

methods.name: hasCoarseLocationPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION permission.

methods.name: handleLocationGet
methods.description: Main method to handle location fetch requests, including permission verification, parameter parsing, and error handling.

methods.name: parseLocationParams
methods.description: Parses JSON string parameters for location request settings such as maxAgeMs, timeoutMs, and desiredAccuracy.
